_purpose: Drives the Designer agent's auto-rendered 1080x1080 cards (lib/canvas-render.js DESIGN_CONFIG / NICHE_PALETTES). Defines brand colors, fonts, and a palette per content type. Brand pink is logo-matched magenta (#EC008C); Dave can fine-tune against the exact Canva brand-kit hex later if needed.

accent.use: occasional warm signature touches — use sparingly

fonts.note: Use fonts available to skia-canvas in the container, or bundle the .ttf files. Bebas Neue + Inter are both free and render cleanly server-side.

text_overlay.note: Applied over stock/lifestyle photos for text legibility — same approach Milly uses for Reeve.

product_feature.headline: #1A1A1D
product_feature.note: Prefer real product photo background where available; gradient is fallback.

dave_product_mockups.note: Drop into milly/assets/products/ named by catalog key (e.g. unisex_tee.png). Designer agent picks by the post's product field.

dave_lifestyle_photos.source: Dave's own photos of people wearing products

ai_generated_lifestyle.source: AI-generated images of people wearing products
ai_generated_lifestyle.note: Generate externally (your image tool of choice), drop into milly/assets/lifestyle/. Keep faces non-identifiable to protect anonymity if any real likeness is involved; AI-generated avoids that entirely.

stock_photo.note: Niche-matched trade photos as overlay backgrounds for non-product posts.

gradient_fallback.note: Uses palettes_by_type gradients. Guarantees a render even with zero external calls.

_meta.note: canvas-render.js currently has 6 hand-tuned palettes for Reeve. Replace its palette object with palettes_by_type above (keys must match the content types the Generator emits). Adding the product-image lookup is a small Designer change — flagged in CONFIG_README.md.
